replies.author: Mango_
replies.body:
Hello,

Fly hacking is extremely easy to detect, and our staff do not mistake it for simple client lag. In addition to that, you have been evading this ban on another account by the name of 'coolsurfman'. Ban evading is strictly prohibited which means this appeal has been denied. In future please explain the situation truthfully if you want any chance of getting unbanned.

Regards,
Mango_
